candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Transverse-Drainage Knickpoint-Lineament, Multi-Scale Scarp Polarity & Distance-Adaptive Bayesian Completeness Fusion
layers_used: data/external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif (ex_mean, downface_max, upface_max, cross_max, coh_100m, strike, valid_n)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_mechanism: Quaternary and late Cenozoic normal/transtensional faults crossing range fronts and piedmont fans perturb longitudinal stream profiles (creating knickpoints, elevated area-normalized k_sn, and cross-divide chi asymmetry that align transverse to regional drainage flow) and form asymmetric unidirectional scarp faces (1 m LiDAR downface-vs-upface polarity aligned with basement gravity strike and 10 m DEM sub-pixel planar breaklines) plus shallow brittle demagnetization dipoles relative to 150 m upward-continued magnetics and U/Th/K hydrothermal redox mobility. Combining these 12 label-blind channels with Distance-Adaptive Bayesian Completeness Fusion prevents visible-catalogue distance features from suppressing unmapped piedmont and intra-basin faults.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Differential lithologic resistance ledges (welded ash-flow tuff caprock steps in incised volcanic canyons), Pleistocene pluvial Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines, and U-rich felsic rhyolite domes / placer fan aprons.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.how_it_differs_from_prior_lanes: No prior lane in GEMSDOE88 or sibling repos extracted interfluve-interpolated stream knickpoint density (knick_n/chan_n), cross-divide chi step asymmetry, transverse-to-drainage knickpoint coherence, 1 m LiDAR unidirectional down/up-face polarity, LiDAR-to-basement gravity strike concordance, 10 m DEM sub-pixel planar breakline sharpness, or upward-continued TMI_up150 depth-attenuation dipole, nor replaced ADHR's static 50/50 completeness mix with a distance-adaptive completeness schedule and far-basin specialist.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Geologic-Map Contact Truncation Density & Quaternary Juxtaposition Torque
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_mechanism: Dip-slip faults truncate pre-Quaternary bedrock contacts at high angles and juxtapose Quaternary alluvium against older units along linear range fronts.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Onlap unconformities and sinuous depositional alluvial fan margins.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.how_it_differs_from_prior_lanes: Uses 1:500k geologic polygon T-junction density rather than scalar unit class.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Sentinel-2 Iron-Oxide / Clay Argillic Alteration Corridor Anisotropy
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_mechanism: Epithermal argillic/illite/hematite alteration haloes along conductive fault damage zones create directional clay+ferric iron bands.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Evaporite playa salt/clay crusts and weathered volcanic talus.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.how_it_differs_from_prior_lanes: Uses oriented anisotropic filtering of Sentinel-2 clay/ferric ratios.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: COMET LiCSAR Vertical-East Strain-Rate Curvature & Subsidence Hinge
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_mechanism: Differential compaction and creep across buried basin faults create strain-rate inflection hinges in InSAR Up/East velocity.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Agricultural groundwater pumping cones and geothermal production drawdowns.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.how_it_differs_from_prior_lanes: Uses second-order horizontal curvature of InSAR velocities rather than raw velocity gradient.

preregistered_experiments.description: Zero-catalogue 56-channel (44 physics + 12 TDKL) dual-expectation ensemble; tests whether the 12 new TDKL geomorphic/LiDAR/upward-magnetic/redox channels improve pure label-blind fault discovery over CGO-88 (0.09042) and Base283 (0.10854).

79-channel (44 physics + 12 TDKL + 23 visible structure) bagged specialist ensemble with static global completeness fusion (pi_unmapped=0.50); isolates feature + ensemble gain over h88_adhr_incumbent.

Full H88-TDKL: 79-channel specialist ensemble + far-basin TDKL specialist + Distance-Adaptive Bayesian Completeness Fusion (radial transition from stepover/relay PoE near mapped traces to TDKL+Far specialist in unmapped basins).
